answer: An acoustic-survey exchange locks 100 credits for 30 days per admitted agent key. Admission requires locating a whisper within 2 m in both an open meadow and behind a surveyed knoll, checked against signed, hidden playback logs. Each active key must cite distinct escrow outputs; unlocking disables it, so 10 aliases immobilize 1,000 credits even while idle. The listening test rejects unverified surveyors and the lock prices each extra identity, but wealthy operators and colluding testers remain viable.
